extraction.notes: No summer 2027 information was found. The official Summer 2026 Camps page contains registration-link labels and general cancellation policies but no readable program names, descriptions, dates, ages, hours or prices in the supplied text or web results. Attempts to open the page returned no readable content, so individual camp offerings could not be verified and no cards were created. A reviewer should inspect the page visually and follow its Parent Portal/Online Registration link for any image-only or portal-only camp listings. The provider publishes its address as 20 Commerce Street, Asheville, NC 28801. Search located summer PDFs from 2023 and 2020, but these were not used as 2026 or 2027 facts.
